**Used by:** `toggle`

| Option | Type | Required | Default | Description | Example |
|--------|------|----------|---------|-------------|---------|
| `options` | any[] | No |  | Array of option items rendered as toggle buttons | `[{"label":"Yes","value":true},{"label":"No","value":false}]` |
| `values` | any[] | No |  | Alias for options (deprecated — prefer options) |  |
| `labelKey` | string | No |  | Object key used as the button label | `"label"` |
| `valueKey` | string | No |  | Object key used as the stored value | `"value"` |
| `storeValue` | boolean | No |  | Store option[valueKey] instead of the whole option object |  |
| `clearable` | boolean | No | `true` | Clicking the active button again clears the value |  |
| `color` | string | No | `"primary"` | Color token applied to the active button | `"primary"`, `"secondary"` |
